subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose when a spawned subagent reaches lost-context, error, timeout, or killed terminal state?
rationale: The missing emission point is clear, but schema, privacy/cardinality rules, and whether the exporter should create a child span or annotate the parent spawn span are public observability contract choices.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

options.title: Annotate spawn span only
options.body: Attach terminal information to the existing `sessions_spawn` tool span, accepting weaker coverage for deaths that happen after the tool call has returned.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle redesign
options.body: Fold this into broader lifecycle/audit work and accept that downstream subagent-death clustering remains blind until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a new trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the subagent registry and gateway-runtime lifecycle surfaces points to this owner.
